data.gender_notes: Mainul is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mainul is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'moon'. In Hindu mythology, the moon is considered a symbol of peace, tranquility, and calmness. It is also associated with the god Chandra, who is known for his wisdom and compassion. The name Mainul carries the meaning “Moon” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mainul usually hope their child will grow to embody moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Peaceful and calm like the moon.
data.etymology: Mainul belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mainul total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

historical_references.reference: Mainul Haque was a Bengali Muslim leader who participated in the Indian independence movement. He was a close associate of Subhas Chandra Bose and was the President of the Indian National Congress during the Quit India Movement in 1942.
historical_references.context: Indian independence movement and Quit India Movement

historical_references.reference: Mainul Haque was a medieval Bengali poet who wrote in the Braj Bhasha language and is known for his love poetry. He was a contemporary of the famous poet Chandidas and is believed to have lived during the late 13th to early 14th century.
